title: ODE Existence, Uniqueness and Solution Structure
description: Initial value problems, Picard-Lindelöf, Peano, Grönwall, continuation, linear systems, and flows (D01-D14)

declarations.name: First-Order Initial Value Problem
declarations.scope_summary: Vector field f: U subset R x R^n -> R^n, initial condition (t0, y0)
declarations.statement_summary: A differentiable curve y: I -> R^n is a solution to the IVP y' = f(t, y), y(t0) = y0.

declarations.name: Separable, Exact and First-Order Linear Equations
declarations.scope_summary: Scalar first-order ODEs with explicit integrating factors
declarations.statement_summary: Integration by separation of variables, integrating factors mu(t) = exp(int P(t) dt), and exact differentials.

declarations.name: Picard Integral Operator and Successive Approximations
declarations.statement_summary: Integral formulation (T y)(t) = y0 + int_{t0}^t f(s, y(s)) ds equivalent to IVP for continuous f.

declarations.name: Picard-Lindelöf Local Existence and Uniqueness
declarations.scope_summary: Locally Lipschitz vector fields on open subsets of R x R^n
declarations.statement_summary: If f is continuous and locally Lipschitz in y, there exists a unique local solution on [t0 - h, t0 + h].

declarations.name: Peano Existence Theorem and Nonuniqueness Boundary
declarations.scope_summary: Continuous vector fields on finite-dimensional R^n
declarations.statement_summary: Continuity alone guarantees existence of at least one local solution; uniqueness may fail (e.g. y' = 2 sqrt(|y|)).

declarations.name: Grönwall Inequality and Continuous Dependence
declarations.statement_summary: Yields exponential bounds on error propagation: ||y_1(t) - y_2(t)|| <= ||y_{1,0} - y_{2,0}|| exp(L |t - t0|).

declarations.name: Maximal Interval of Existence and Boundary Escape
declarations.statement_summary: As t approaches an endpoint of the maximal interval, (t, y(t)) escapes every compact subset of the domain U.

declarations.name: Global Existence under Sublinear/Linear Growth
declarations.scope_summary: Vector fields satisfying ||f(t, y)|| <= a(t) ||y|| + b(t)
declarations.statement_summary: Sublinear growth bounds prevent finite-time blowup and ensure global existence for all t in R.

declarations.name: Differentiable Parameter Dependence and Variational Equations
declarations.scope_summary: C^k vector fields with respect to state and parameters
declarations.statement_summary: The flow Phi(t, t0, x) is C^k with derivative W(t) = partial_x Phi satisfying the linear variational ODE W' = Df(t, y(t)) W.

declarations.name: Linear ODE Systems and Variation of Constants
declarations.scope_summary: Linear systems y' = A(t) y + g(t)
declarations.statement_summary: Solutions form an n-dimensional vector space; fundamental matrix Phi(t); variation of constants formula y(t) = Phi(t) y0 + int Phi(t) Phi(s)^(-1) g(s) ds.

declarations.name: Floquet Theory for Periodic Linear Systems
declarations.scope_summary: T-periodic linear systems y' = A(t) y with A(t+T) = A(t)
declarations.statement_summary: Fundamental matrix factors as Phi(t) = P(t) exp(t R) where P(t) is T-periodic and R is a constant matrix; monodromy matrix M = exp(T R).

declarations.name: Autonomous Phase Flow and Local Group Action
declarations.statement_summary: Flow Phi^t satisfies group composition Phi^{t+s} = Phi^t circ Phi^s wherever both sides are defined.

declarations.name: Complex Analytic ODEs and Frobenius Method
declarations.scope_summary: Linear ODEs with regular singular points in C
declarations.statement_summary: Power series and Frobenius series solutions with indicial equation roots determining logarithmic terms.

declarations.name: Sturm Comparison and Separation Theorems
declarations.scope_summary: Second-order linear ODEs -(p y')' + q y = 0
declarations.statement_summary: Zeros of linearly independent solutions strictly interlace; Sturm comparison theorem bounds zero distribution.
